Correcting each by d_i/2 leaves its tail >=a_i-ell and its head <=ell, both in the box. If a neighboring correction raises the tail of an inactive link, that tail is <=ell<=a_j-ell; if it lowers the head, that head is >=ell and the tail is <=a_j. Either bound suffices even when the link is flanked by two active edges. The residual is a nonnegative combination of tight normals, proving the unique minimizer, and disjoint supports give squared norm sum(d_i^2)/2. Equality at the sharp bound requires a maximum matching with every matched pair at (a_i,0); the two perfect matchings for even s and the unique matching leaving each prescribed vertex unmatched for odd s prove the complete locus. The expansion over a matching uses inclusive joint violations, not independence conditional on the exact active set. The deficit density on a violated pair is 2(ell-u)/ell^2, giving the stated Laplace factor, first moment and zero atom.
